items.title: Sushi & sashimi
items.text: Hamachi sashimi, nigiri, maki, maguro zuke don and more sushi prepared at the event.

details.intro: Fresh fish and sushi prepared during Japan Day.

items.name: Hamachi sashimi
items.description: Fresh slices of hamachi served in a simple Japanese style that lets the fish speak for itself.

items.name: Negi-hama maki
items.description: Maki sushi with hamachi and spring onion.

items.name: Tekka maki
items.description: Classic thin maki sushi with tuna.

items.name: Maguro zuke don
items.description: A rice bowl with tuna marinated in the zuke style.

items.name: Sake don
items.description: A Japanese rice bowl with salmon.

items.name: Nigiri
items.description: Traditional nigiri sushi prepared on site.

items.name: Sushi set
items.description: A combination of hamachi and ebi nigiri.

items.title: Japanese food & grill
items.text: Buta no kakuni, hayashi rice, grilled saba, miso pork and a Wagyu-style burger.

details.intro: Warm Japanese dishes and specialities prepared on the grill.

items.name: Buta no kakuni
items.description: Slow-cooked Japanese-style pork served with rice.

items.name: Hayashi rice
items.description: A popular Japanese dish with rice and a rich dark sauce.

items.name: Yaki sakana – saba
items.description: Grilled mackerel prepared in a simple Japanese style.

items.name: Butaniku no miso yaki
items.description: Pork marinated in miso, served with salad and dressing.

items.name: Wagyu-style burger
items.description: A Japanese-style beef burger with salad, onion and ninniku-miso mayonnaise.

items.title: Japanese tea
items.text: Three tea stations with a broad selection, from sencha and gyokuro to oolong, wakocha and white tea.

details.intro: Japanese teas will be prepared at three separate tea stations by Martin Kindl, Jiří Houska and Tomáš Pelich, experienced tea enthusiasts.
details.secondary: Visitors can compare different ways of processing, flavours and styles of Japanese tea preparation throughout the day.

items.name: Sencha
items.description: Japanese steamed green tea rolled into needle-shaped leaves.

items.name: Kamairicha
items.description: Japanese green tea processed by pan-firing.

items.name: Gyokuro
items.description: Japanese green tea known for being shaded before harvest.

items.name: Oolong
items.description: Tea with partially oxidised leaves.

items.name: Wakocha
items.description: Japanese black tea.

items.name: Kurocha
items.description: Japanese fermented tea.

items.name: Hōjicha
items.description: Roasted Japanese green tea.

items.name: White tea / Hakucha / Shirocha
items.description: A gently processed white tea.

items.title: Sake & whisky
items.text: Five different sakes from Shizuoka, Kanagawa and Osaka, plus Japanese whisky.

details.intro: Nagomi Sake will offer a tasting of five different sakes from several regions of Japan, allowing visitors to compare regional styles and producers.

items.name: Japanese whisky
items.description: Japanese whisky will also be available.
